175786.name: rps-12

175788.name: rcan-1

175796.name: rpl-23

175811.name: ceh-10
175811.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in blindness; corneal dystrophy; isolated microphthalmia 2; keratoconus; and posterior polymorphous corneal dystrophy 1. 175817.name: mdt-15

175819.name: cct-6
175819.summary: Predicted to enable unfolded protein binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein folding. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. 175836.name: tdo-2
175836.summary: Predicted to enable L-tryptophan 2,3-dioxygenase activity and heme binding activity. Predicted to be involved in L-tryptophan catabolic process. Is expressed in body wall musculature and hypodermis. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Gilles de la Tourette syndrome and familial hypertryptophanemia. Orthologous to human TDO2 (tryptophan 2,3-dioxygenase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175853.name: cyk-3
175853.summary: Enables cysteine-type deubiquitinase activity. Orthologous to several human genes including USP32 (ubiquitin specific peptidase 32). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175863.name: mvk-1
175863.summary: Predicted to enable ATP binding activity and mevalonate kinase activity. Predicted to be involved in isoprenoid biosynthetic process. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in body wall musculature; head; nervous system; and reproductive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hyperimmunoglobulinemia D periodic fever syndrome; lipid metabolism disorder; mevalonic aciduria; and porokeratosis. Orthologous to human MVK (mevalonate kinase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175879.name: rps-3

175898.nomenclaturename: KH domain-containing protein akap-1;Tudor domain-containing protein

175913.name: vps-16

175926.name: F23F12.3
175926.summary: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC22A11 (solute carrier family 22 member 11); SLC22A13 (solute carrier family 22 member 13); and SLC22A14 (solute carrier family 22 member 14). 175934.name: let-765
175934.summary: Predicted to enable chromatin DNA binding activity and histone binding activity. Orthologous to several human genes including SBNO1 (strawberry notch homolog 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175936.name: mdh-2
175936.summary: Enables L-malate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity. Involved in malate metabolic process. Located in mitochondrion. Is expressed in body wall musculature; intestine; and pharynx. Used to study hyperglycemia. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 51. Orthologous to human MDH2 (malate dehydrogenase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175966.name: inf-1
175966.summary: Predicted to enable translation initiation factor activity. Predicted to be involved in cytoplasmic translational initiation. Predicted to be located in P granule. Orthologous to several human genes including EIF4A1 (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4A1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175972.name: rpn-6.1
175972.summary: Predicted to enable structural molecule activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan; proteasome assembly; and ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. 175975.name: eef-1A.1

176001.name: nuo-4

176005.name: acs-4
176005.summary: Predicted to enable long-chain fatty acid-CoA ligase activity. Orthologous to human ACSL3 (acyl-CoA synthetase long chain family member 3) and ACSL4 (acyl-CoA synthetase long chain family member 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

176006.name: rps-14
176006.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in ribosomal small subunit assembly and translation. Predicted to be located in cytosolic ribosome and nucleolus. Predicted to be part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit and small-subunit processome. 176022.name: adr-2

Orthologous to several human genes including ADARB1 (adenosine deaminase RNA specific B1) and ADARB2 (adenosine deaminase RNA specific B2 (inactive)). 176023.name: ndus-8

176155.name: unc-36

176285.name: mrpl-44
